question: Who among the following Delhi sultans accidentally died during a game of polo in the year 1210?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qutbuddin Aibak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Qutbuddin Aibak** was the founder of the **Slave Dynasty** and the first ruler of the Delhi Sultanate. His reign marked the establishment of Muslim rule in Northern India.
 
• He ruled from **1206 to 1210** and was a former slave of **Muhammad Ghori**. After Ghori's assassination, Aibak declared himself the ruler of the territories in India.
